leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a MinStack class with a constructor that initializes two arrays for primary storage and minimum tracking.
Implement a push method that adds a value to the stack while updating the current minimum.
Implement a pop method that removes the top element from the stack and updates the minimum tracking accordingly.
Apply a top method to retrieve the last element added to the stack without removing it.
Manipulate the getMin method to return the current minimum element in constant time.
Integrate the MinStack methods to handle edge cases such as an empty stack.
